paper_title: A Universal Bound on QCD Axions from Supernovae
suggested_experiment_name: SN 1987A model-independent QCD axion bound (This work)
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (inverse axion decay constant) as plotted on y-axis; x-axis is m_a in eV
notes: Model-independent SN1987A cooling bound on the QCD axion. Main result: f_a > 1.1e8 GeV, equivalently m_a < 5.3e-2 eV, quoted at 68% C.L. (paper states 68%, not 90/95%; forced to 0.90 by enum). Exclusion plot Fig.5 is 1/f_a vs m_a plane, so AxionMass is appropriate. The bound is a single point on the QCD axion line (excluded region m_a > 5.3e-2 eV / f_a < 1.1e8 GeV).
